overview: The Medford School Committee met to review community feedback on space utilization, receive an update on the high school building project, and approve a solar power purchase agreement. The committee also approved a policy governing generative artificial intelligence and entered executive session for collective bargaining.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss collective bargaining with the Medford Teachers Association regarding a grievance.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payrolls, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and minutes.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Roberts Rampage Newspaper
items.summary: Students and staff from Roberts Elementary School presented their student-run newspaper, the Roberts Rampage.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews Solar Projects Presentation
items.summary: Approved a power purchase agreement for a solar project at the McGlynn school, with a directive to investigate expanding the agreement to other schools.

items.title: Community Input and Space Utilization Presentation
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi presented findings from a community survey regarding proposed K-4 and middle school space reconfiguration options.

items.title: MHS Building Project (MSBA) Update
items.summary: Member Graham provided an update on the Medford High School project, outlining the design contract signature, educational visioning, and upcoming community advisory teams.

items.title: Generative AI Policy Second Reading
items.summary: Approved the second reading of a policy regulating the use of generative artificial intelligence in the district.

items.title: Condolences and Announcements
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of Anna M. Frontavera and Janice Rumley-Ahearn, and announced upcoming municipal events.
